resources.string: An on-device agent that can see the screen, tap, type, open apps and call app functions — no cable required. Turn Agent on, connect a brain, then give it a goal.

This may involve payment or credentials. Confirm on the phone.
Connect any OpenAI-compatible API. Screen text and labels go to your endpoint while a task runs — never to BestROM.
Password fields are omitted. Screenshots only if you enable them. BestROM operates no model endpoint.

Pick any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, Groq, Gemini's OpenAI path, OpenRouter, a self-hosted llama.cpp/Ollama server, or Custom with your own base URL and API key.

While a task runs, everything the agent reads is sent to that endpoint with your key: screen text, element labels, installed app names and labels, and app functions this phone publishes. Screenshots go only if you turn them on. Password fields are left out.

Autonomy in Brain settings chooses how far the agent may go: Assist asks each action; Task auto-confirms inside one goal; Background adds idle-drain sampling; Maintainer adds redacted logs for next-build fixes; Full unlocks all of those. Payment and credential apps still ask every time. BestROM runs none of the model providers and receives none of the traffic.
The key could not be sealed. Set a screen lock and try again.
Send screenshots (the model must accept images)
Off. Reading the screen as text costs far less.
A screenshot costs more than an entire ten step task. Only turn this on for a model that can see images.

The agent will tap, type, open apps and change settings without asking, for the whole task, driven by a model whose input includes text that apps and other people wrote. Payment and credential apps still ask every time, and the refused settings stay refused.
Actions run without asking, inside a task.
Background unlocks measure_idle_drain and repeating start_job (idle_drain / error_watch). Payment apps and refused settings still ask or refuse.
Maintainer unlocks redacted log_tail, log_grep and crash_scan so maintainers can fix the next build. Logs can contain app text; secrets are redacted but treat this as sensitive.
Full includes Background, Maintainer and macros (notify, drain, crash scan, or run_goal when Agent is on). Payment and credential apps still ask every time. There is still no shell tool.
Auto keeps every Full tool, and skips confirm sheets that are not payment, credential or checkout. Wallets, Paytm, and Place order still ask. Refused settings stay refused.
Bypass skips every confirm sheet, including payment and credential apps. Refused settings (lock screen, developer options, accessibility, wipe) still refuse. Only use this on a phone you control.
Task plus battery jobs and idle drain sampling.
Background plus redacted logs for fixes.
Full tools; only payment / checkout still ask.
No confirm sheets. Forbidden settings still refuse.
